mapper.select: SELECT s.DEVICE_ID AS deviceId, s.CREATE_DATE AS createDate, s.TEMP_C AS tempC, s.HUMIDITY AS humidity, s.SOIL_MOISTURE_VALUE AS soilMoistureValue, s.LDR_VALUE AS ldrValue, s.FAN_STATUS AS fanStatus, s.LED_STATUS AS ledStatus, s.PUMP_STATUS AS pumpStatus, c.CROP_NAME AS crops, COALESCE(das.TEMP_MIN, def.TEMP_MIN) AS tempMin, COALESCE(das.TEMP_MAX, def.TEMP_MAX) AS tempMax, COALESCE(das.SOIL_MIN, def.SOIL_MIN) AS soilMin, COALESCE(das.SOIL_MAX, def.SOIL_MAX) AS soilMax, COALESCE(das.LUX_MIN, def.LUX_MIN) AS luxMin, COALESCE(das.LUX_MAX, def.LUX_MAX) AS luxMax, COALESCE(das.HUMIDITY_MIN, def.HUMIDITY_MIN) AS humidityMin, COALESCE(das.HUMIDITY_MAX, def.HUMIDITY_MAX) AS humidityMax FROM SENSOR_DATA s JOIN DEVICE d ON s.DEVICE_ID = d.DEVICE_ID JOIN CROP c ON d.CROP_ID = c.CROP_ID -- 농작물명과 일치하는 기준값 (없으면 null) LEFT JOIN DEVICE_ACTUATOR_STANDARD das ON das.CROPS = c.CROP_NAME -- 기본값 (default row) LEFT JOIN DEVICE_ACTUATOR_STANDARD def ON def.CROPS = 'default' WHERE d.CROP_ID = #{cropId} AND d.IS_ACTIVE = 1 ORDER BY s.CREATE_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE DEVICE_ACTUATOR_STANDARD SET TEMP_MIN = #{tempMin}, TEMP_MAX = #{tempMax}, HUMIDITY_MIN = #{humidityMin}, HUMIDITY_MAX = #{humidityMax}, SOIL_MIN = #{soilMin}, SOIL_MAX = #{soilMax}, LUX_MIN = #{luxMin}, LUX_MAX = #{luxMax} WHERE CROPS = #{crops}
